3	- D-t02: Build against API version v1 with base path api.base_path = AX-25930 (error format api.error_format = AX-78362). Relies on facts: style_guide.api_version = v1, api.base_path = AX-25930, api.error_format = AX-78362. The facts match repo/api.py, so no conflict.

Relies on facts: security.auth_method (JWT bearer, RS256, 15 min) and customer.auth_method (long-lived API key in `X-Api-Key`). The two conflict; security.auth_method governs because it is the security team's policy and long-lived static keys weaken it. Globex's request is not adopted for user traffic; it is deferred to the account team/security as a separate, scoped machine-credential proposal (e.g. restricted, revocable service tokens) needing security sign-off. Nothing in the code is changed for it now.
